MortyIntroText:
Good of you to
have come.

Here in ECRUTEAK,
#MON have been revered.

It's said that a
rainbow-colored

#MON will come
down to appear

before a truly
powerful trainer.

I believed that
tale, so I have

secretly trained
here all my life.

As a result, I can
now see what others cannot.

Just a bit more…

With a little
more, I could see

a future in which
I meet the #MON of rainbow colors.

You're going to
help me reach that level!
MortyWinLossText:
I'm not good
enough yet…

All right. This
BADGE is yours.
MortyText_FogBadgeSpeech:
By having FOG-
BADGE, #MON up

to L50 will obey
you.

Also, #MON that
know SURF will be

able to use that
move anytime.

I want you to have
this too.
MortyText_ShadowBallSpeech:
It's SHADOW BALL.
It causes damage

and may reduce
SPCL.DEF.

Use it if it
appeals to you.
MortyFightDoneText:
I see…

Your journey has
taken you to far- away places.

And you have wit-
nessed much more than I.

I envy you for
that…
SageJeffreySeenText:
I spent the spring
with my #MON.

Then summer, fall
and winter…

Then spring came
again. We have

lived together
for a long time.
SageJeffreyBeatenText:
Wins and losses, I
experienced both.
SagePingSeenText:
Can you inflict
any damage on our #MON?
SagePingAfterBattleText:
We use only ghost-
type #MON.

No normal-type
attack can harm them!
MediumMarthaAfterBattleText:
The one who wants
to win most--will!
MediumGraceSeenText:
Stumped by our in-
visible floor?

Defeat me if you
want a hint!
MediumGraceAfterBattleText:
Fine. I shall tell
you the secret of

the invisible
floor.

The path is right
before our eyes!
EcruteakGymGuideText:
The trainers here
have secret mo- tives.

If you win, they
may tell you some

deep secrets about
ECRUTEAK.
EcruteakGymGuideWinText:
Whew, {PLAYER}.
You did great!

I was cowering in
the corner out of pure terror!
EcruteakGymClosedText:
MORTY, the GYM
LEADER, is absent.

Sorry, but you'll
have to leave.

Hohohoho.
